subject: dym-spt
title: DYM.SPT.------IST.F.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-4. The crossing diagrams how dynamic-spirituality structurally meets isolated-focus at the projectional-continuum scale: DYM-SPT (dynamic spirituality) crossed with IST-F (isolated focus). DYM-SPT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; IST-F at center-right as partner-axis. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and SF-RZ (self-realization) at upper margin with AFI (affinity insight) on the right. A-PR (applied projection), SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics), DYM-F (dynamic form) on the subject's left chain. R-TM (reality of matrix), LG-DY (linguistic dynamics), LANG-DY (language dynamics) on the bridging-axis. RT-DY (reality dynamics) at center-right. Structural argument: when dynamic-spirituality is crossed with isolated-focus, the upper diagonal AF-DY -> SF-RZ -> AFI is the partner-axis upper route - affinity-dynamics routes through self-realization into affinity-insight. The subject's left chain A-PR -> SOC-RT-DY -> DYM-F is what dynamic-spirituality produces alone. The bridging-axis R-TM -> LG-DY -> LANG-DY carries the form's language working into the partner-axis.
